# DPIA outline for a platform workload (Appendix C.8, Section 10.6)

| # | Section | Source |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Processing description and purpose | Intake record |
| 2 | Data inventory and classes | Catalog references; matrix decision |
| 3 | Legal basis and transparency | Intake record; disclosure template version |
| 4 | Necessity and proportionality | Written by the DPO and the owning team |
| 5 | Isolation and security controls | Tenant record; `governance/controls-matrix.yaml` |
| 6 | Model and output controls | Guardrail profile; red-team results; quality SLO |
| 7 | Data-subject rights | Deletion pipeline completion reports; art. 20 review path if applicable |
| 8 | Residual risk and decision | Written by the DPO; signed by the accountable owner |
